summary: Smart Sand, Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose adoption of a Rule 10b5-1 trading plan for its share repurchase program, authorizing up to $2.5 million in buybacks. Trades may commence June 1, 2026, and expire upon full use or August 10, 2026. The plan allows repurchases during blackout periods via a broker. No price or premium is specified. This is a capital return event executed through open-market repurchases. Watch for periodic disclosures of actual repurchase activity in subsequent 10-Q/K filings; risk-arb angle is not applicable as it is a non-discretionary buyback plan.
